reason: The hypothesis combines the solid-state repair concept of FSP (known for aluminum and some nickel alloys) with a post-process re-aging treatment specifically designed to restore the precipitation-hardened microstructure of the notoriously unweldable Inconel 713C. No passage proposes FSP as a direct repair method for Inconel 713C, nor does any passage combine FSP with a re-aging step to address the dissolution of strengthening precipitates in this alloy. The idea transfers FSP to a new, challenging material regime and links it to a mechanism (precipitate restoration) not stated in the provided literature.
